prompt:
A photorealistic portrait of a young woman with long, voluminous, tightly curled auburn-brown hair and soft face-framing bangs, leaning casually against a weathered stone balustrade. She has a gentle side-glance and a subtle closed-mouth smile, a small gold nose ring, and dark burgundy nails. She wears an ornate ivory lace blouse with floral embroidery, ruffled high neckline, and puffed long sleeves, paired with black bottoms. Black sunglasses rest loosely in her hand on the railing.

Golden-hour sunset over a wide body of water, warm amber and peach light reflecting on gentle ripples. In the background, a historic city skyline with a large domed mosque and minarets, plus a classic white ferry boat crossing the water. Soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, rich warm color grade, high detail, 85mm portrait look.

She wears a relaxed white linen button-down shirt with a few top buttons naturally open and matching loose white linen pants. A dark wooden structure overhead and a black metal chain railing frame the foreground.
